snippet.title: Squish
snippet.description:
Squish is my entry into TIGSource's Bootleg Demake contest. It's the PSP puzzle game "Crush" reimagined in 2D!

For more info, check out the TIGSource thread here:
http://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=2822.0

You can download it from my website here:
http://distractionware.com/blog/?p=254
